source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Monitoring for signs of hepatic encephalopathy (a recognized complication), bleeding at the access site, and shunt patency","B":"Fairly little specific monitoring actually being needed beyond what standard post-procedure care would already cover","C":"Monitoring considered essentially identical to what would follow a simple, routine venipuncture procedure","D":"Monitoring considered relevant mainly during the first hour after the procedure, rather than for the following days"}}
source_row.rationale: Post-TIPS monitoring includes watching for signs of hepatic encephalopathy (a recognized complication since the shunt diverts blood around the liver, reducing ammonia clearance), bleeding at the access site, and shunt patency, given the significant physiologic changes this procedure creates.
source_row.source_name: AASLD — TIPS Procedure Nursing Care Guidelines
